message.content: Both lions (family *Felidae*) and zebras (*Equus* spp.) belong to the order **Carnivora** and **Perissodactyla**, respectively—two distinct orders within mammals. Their most recent shared ancestor was an ancient placental mammal that lived roughly **180–190 million years ago during the Early Jurassic period**. This ancestral species would have been part of the group known as **Eutheria** (placentals), predating the divergence into separate lineages such as carnivores and odd‑toed ungulates.
